name: Replicating Dr. GRPO
result: RL post training on Qwen2.5-1.5B, GRPO against Dr. GRPO on the paper's own setup. The accuracy claim held (51.6% vs 51.2% on MATH500). Both length claims came out reversed. One seed, 100 LoRA steps.

name: Tool Dependency Graph
result: Works out which agent tools have to run before which, from nothing but their JSON Schemas. 1,391 tools, 46 typed entities, 3,278 edges, 8 of 8 hand written assertions passing.

name: Distributed ViT on CIFAR-10
result: Data parallel training on 2x T4, with gradient equivalence tested before any speed was measured. Scaling efficiency was 98% in fp32 and 57% in fp16; 24 measured runs traced the drop to the host's 4 vCPUs.

name: ZTF Transient Pipeline
result: Replays a real night of ZTF alerts (27,378 Avro packets) through Kafka. 500 were loaded, scored by a multimodal CNN, and rebuilt in a dbt warehouse with 8 models and 21 tests. Coarse labels; a systems project first.
stack: Kafka, Avro, TensorFlow, dbt, DuckDB, Airflow

name: Groundwork
result: RAG evaluation, guardrails, and an LLM gateway on SQuAD v2.0. recall@5 0.921, ECE 0.045, prompt injection recall 0.884 on an unseen attack corpus, 113 tests.

name: Replicating BEIR
result: Six published retrieval results reproduced, four exact to three decimals. The one that missed came from a silent 100 token truncation default in the DPR encoder.

name: JMA Wireless
result: Led a four person Lean Six Sigma team at a maker of cell tower and 5G equipment. Flattened 31 GB of nested PLC JSON to under 5 MB for Power BI. About $355K a year in projected opportunity, pending JMA Finance confirmation.

name: ShopFloor AI
result: Predictive maintenance on the AI4I 2020 dataset (0.85 F1, 0.96 AUC), Kafka KPI streaming, and RAG over 6 bundled SOPs, run as a seven service Docker Compose stack.

name: handoff
result: Supervisor orchestration where every escalation has a deadline and a declared outcome when nobody answers: ladder, safer substitute, drop, or freeze. 212 tests, no dependencies, simulated cluster, no LLM calls.

name: comms-agent
result: A stateful agent with a human review gate inside its control flow. On the sample run it flags 9 of 24 mentions and the reviewer corrects 7. Synthetic corpus, mock model, simulated reviewer.

name: Project Mark
result: Four families of analytics traps with deterministic golden solutions, built to stress test frontier models. The models solved the clean versions.

name: media-pulse
result: Media monitoring with confidence gated human review. Review lifts topic accuracy from 0.88 to 0.96 and sentiment from 0.50 to 0.85; ECE 0.156. Synthetic corpus about a fictional brand.

name: Kp Index Forecasting
result: LSTM forecasts of the geomagnetic Kp index from solar wind data. At 1 hour, RMSE 0.738, 45% better than a mean baseline, over 96,000+ hourly observations.

name: The Perfect Lap
result: Predicts the first pit stop lap in Formula 1. MAE 2.78 laps on 250,000+ records, with a Streamlit app.

name: July Energy Demand Under Warming
result: Models July residential demand: +25.4% peak hour load at +5°C, and 9.2% savings from a 1°C setpoint shift. Random Forest R² 0.48. R and Shiny.

name: Wealth Equals Health?
result: Gapminder data across 180+ countries: how far income explains life expectancy, and whether education does more than income to reduce child mortality. ANOVA F = 426.5.

name: Travel Itinerary Management System
result: A 12 entity normalized SQL schema where stored procedures and triggers enforce the business rules.

name: Uber Data Engineering Pipeline
result: A GCP pipeline into a BigQuery star schema.

name: Digit Recognition from Scratch
result: A neural network in NumPy with hand written backpropagation. 94% on MNIST.

name: Real Time Big Data Inflow
result: A literature review of 12+ primary sources comparing cloud and tiered edge architectures across six dimensions. For suitably partitioned workloads the comparison puts the latency reduction at 40 to 60%.
